apps.localizedDescription:
Apps2Samsung installs Jellyfin and other web and community apps onto your Samsung Tizen TV — no PC, no Tizen Studio, and no manual sideloading.

This is the mobile (phone) installer head of Apps2Samsung. Put your TV into Developer Mode, point the app at it over your local network, sign in once with a free Samsung account to provision a signing certificate, and install.

Features:

* Finds Samsung Tizen TVs on your network, or connect directly by IP.
* Installs Jellyfin (multiple build variants) and a catalog of community apps.
* Give any app a custom launcher icon and a custom title.
* Optional Jellyfin server pre-configuration: server URL, auto-login, and custom CSS.
* Uses a free Samsung account certificate — no paid developer account required.

Requirements:

* A Samsung Tizen TV in Developer Mode, on the same local network as your phone.

Desktop versions for Windows, macOS and Linux are also available. Apps2Samsung is free and open source (MIT).

## 📦 v3.2.0-beta: 2026-10-30


### 🚀 New features
- Certificate sheet: copy the sign-in link for another browser (#912)
- Catalog: carry the Tizen version each package asks for (#926)
- Arm TV-Store with every signing profile this device holds (#927)
### 🐛 Bug fixes
- On the TV: View in catalog crash, search by developer, developer tap, TV-Store catalog button (#888), version 3.2.0 (#906)
- Install: a TV rejecting the certificate is not a certificate mismatch (#907) (#910)
- Certificate rejected [118, -12]: say the TV needs internet to verify it (#907) (#915)
- Arm TV-Store: find a TV-Store installed under a new package id (#839) (#923)
- Back to the package's own id: forget a remembered package-id rename (#839) (#924)
### 🌍 Translations
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#916)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#925)
### 🧰 Maintenance & CI
- Refactor: redesign the Apps2Samsung download page (#904)
- CI: version guard on PRs, pin appimagetool, document the required checks (#908)
- Update Ko-fi link for Patrick's support (#914)
- Notify winget-apps2samsung from the stable release (#918)
- Release workflows: one run at a time per branch (#929)

## New Contributors
* @elias4044 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/pull/904

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/compare/v3.1.0-beta...v3.2.0-beta
